states.name: Neutrals
diplomacy: Hosontia declared a war on its rival Froth
Froth's ally Shunek joined the war on defenders side
Froth's ally Swanpasia joined the war on defenders side
Froth's ally Bhic joined the war on defenders side
Froth's ally Cloudland joined the war on defenders side
Froth's ally Ikhgolgania joined the war on defenders side
Eshlelosa declared a war on its rival Ryuer
Ryuer's ally Bhic joined the war on defenders side
Ryuer's ally Dhod joined the war on defenders side
Eshlelosa's ally Venorlor did not join the war as its allies are in war on both sides
Adre declared a war on its rival Dhod
Dhod's ally Ryuer joined the war on defenders side
Dhod's ally Swanpasia joined the war on defenders side
Dhod's ally Narant joined the war on defenders side
Adre's ally Shunek avoided entering the war
Adre's ally Cloudland avoided entering the war

notes.name: Ghobagh Healing Stream
notes.legend: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.
